title: RouteIQ — Semantic Cache Analytics
description: Day 63: hit rate, false-positive-rate proxy, and estimated dollars saved for semantic-cache-engine, computed over infra_ai.inference_events' cache_hit / cache_miss / cache_feedback source values (DESIGN.md §5, §8). The three stat panels' rawSql is kept identical to pkg/analytics's HitRateQuery / FalsePositiveProxyQuery / CostSavedQuery constants — edit both together, not just one, or the dashboard and the tested Go logic will drift apart. The false-positive-rate proxy is a lower bound (DESIGN.md §4): it only counts hits a user noticed was wrong and flagged through the thumbs-down webhook (pkg/feedback), not every wrong hit.

list.name: tenant_id
list.label: Tenant ID
list.description: Filters every panel to a single tenant_id, matching DESIGN.md §2's tenant-scoped cache table and this module's tenant-scoped false-positive budget (§4).

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: hits / (hits + misses) over infra_ai.inference_events. Requires cache_miss events (pkg/lensai.SourceCacheMiss, Day 63) as the denominator -- counting cache_hit alone has no "attempted lookups" to divide by. Matches pkg/analytics.HitRateQuery and pkg/analytics.HitRate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  countIf(source = 'cache_hit') AS hits,
  countIf(source = 'cache_miss') AS misses,
  countIf(source = 'cache_hit') / countIf(source IN ('cache_hit', 'cache_miss')) AS hit_rate
FROM infra_ai.inference_events
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: False-Positive Rate Proxy — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: thumbs_down / hits, a LOWER BOUND on DESIGN.md §4's true false-positive rate: only counts hits a user noticed was wrong and flagged via the thumbs-down webhook (pkg/feedback, cmd/feedbackwebhook). Matches pkg/analytics.FalsePositiveProxyQuery and pkg/analytics.FalsePositiveRateProxy. DESIGN.md §4's target upper bound is 0.1% -- thresholds below flag at 0.1% (yellow) and 1% (red) of this proxy, understanding the true rate could be higher.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  countIf(source = 'cache_feedback' AND status = 'thumbs_down') AS thumbs_down,
  countIf(source = 'cache_hit') AS hits,
  countIf(source = 'cache_feedback' AND status = 'thumbs_down') / countIf(source = 'cache_hit') AS false_positive_proxy
FROM infra_ai.inference_events
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)

panels.title: Estimated Cost Saved (USD) — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: hits * average real-inference cost_usd over the same tenant and window -- what those hits would have cost had each one missed and fallen through to inference. cache_hit events always carry cost_usd=0 (pkg/lensai.EmitCacheHit), so this is an estimate built from the tenant's own inference cost mix, not a sum of the ledger's cost_usd column. Matches pkg/analytics.CostSavedQuery and pkg/analytics.EstimatedCostSaved.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  (SELECT countIf(source = 'cache_hit') FROM infra_ai.inference_events
    WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp))
  *
  (SELECT avgIf(cost_usd, source = '' OR source = 'inference') FROM infra_ai.inference_events
    WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND cost_usd > 0)
  AS estimated_cost_saved_usd

panels.title: Hits vs Misses Over Time — ${tenant_id}
panels.description: cache_hit and cache_miss event counts per minute, the raw series the hit-rate stat panel summarizes -- lets an operator see whether a hit-rate dip is a real drop in cache effectiveness or just low traffic (few lookups, high variance).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time,
  source,
  count() AS events
FROM infra_ai.inference_events
WHERE tenant_id = '${tenant_id}' AND source IN ('cache_hit', 'cache_miss') AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
GROUP BY time, source
ORDER BY time
